svg.aria-label: Three graphs stacked on one time axis from 0 to 120 milliseconds, recorded from one skeletal muscle fiber after a single stimulus. Top: membrane potential of the sarcolemma, a brief spike at about 2 to 5 milliseconds, over almost at once. Middle: calcium concentration in the sarcoplasm, which starts rising just after the spike, peaks in under 10 milliseconds and then falls back toward rest over the next 40 to 50 milliseconds. Bottom: force, which starts rising a few milliseconds after the spike, peaks at about 35 milliseconds, well after calcium has peaked, and falls back almost to zero by about 110 milliseconds.
